references.name: text-embeddings-inference
references.procedure: POST /decode then /tokenize to check the rows survive TEI's re-tokenization; then POST /embed with the batch's 32 rows as token ids, 5 untimed then 50 timed, each timed from sending the request to reading the whole response, the p50 and p99 of TEI's x-total-time, x-tokenization-time, x-queue-time, x-inference-time headers beside it, and TEI's /metrics read before and after the timed requests for its te_batch_next_size and te_batch_next_tokens histograms; min_cosine is against the bundle's reference vectors; TEI's router built natively and run on this machine, not in a container; round trip (measured) p50 1295.048 ms, p99 2988.596 ms; TEI's own headers, whole ms, over the same requests: x-total-time p50 1293 p99 2987, x-tokenization-time p50 0 p99 0, x-queue-time p50 115 p99 225, x-inference-time p50 609 p99 2315; TEI's /metrics over the timed requests: 1600 inputs in 50 requests, 150 backend batches (te_batch_next_size's 256 samples less the 106 empty polls te_batch_next_tokens shows), 3.00 batches per request, mean batch size 10.67 inputs (batches by size, 1: 7, 2: 1, 3 to 4: 14, 5 to 8: 55, 9 to 16: 34, 17 to 32: 39); the tool ran unpinned; TEI ran unpinned with the image's thread settings: OMP_NUM_THREADS=unset, MKL_NUM_THREADS=unset, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=unset
